items.clause: Rule 3: every habitable room has direct ventilation to the outside through an opening of at least 1/6 of the room floor area
items.paraphrase: National minimum hygiene order: each day or night room needs an opening to the outside of at least one sixth of its floor area.
items.note: read 2026-11-14: BOE 1 March 1944 pp. 1833-1834; national rule that applies where a region has no own habitability decree; regions override it (Catalonia 1/8 in the es-ct overlay)

items.paraphrase: A straight flight has treads of at least 28 cm.
